title: Investigation into the 43 of Ayotzinapa Is Not Closed, President Sheinbaum Says
author: Fernanda Monroy
content:
_This article by[Fernanda
Monroy](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/fermonroy/) originally appeared in
the [September 28, 2026 edition of
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/investigacion-sobre-
los-43-de-ayotzinapa-no-esta-cerrada-presidenta/), Mexico's premier left wing
daily newspaper._

The investigation to clarify the disappearance of the **43 students of
Ayotzinapa** **is not closed** , emphasized **President Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo** , noting that the **presentation of new progress** on the case does
not represent the culmination of the investigations.

During her morning press conference, the president explained that the report
will be presented before the **Attorney General 's Office and the Interior
Ministry**, and specified that the information to be released has already been
**shared with the parents of the students of the Raúl Isidro Burgos Rural
Normal School**.

> They already know the report. Nothing will be reported that has not been
> reported to them. The only thing that will be reported is what they already
> know.
>
> Claudia Sheinbaum

She detailed that the progress includes **new lines of investigation
developed** through mechanisms and methodologies that, according to what the
president set out, had not been used previously in the investigation files.
**Results obtained from the analysis of the phones used during the events**
will also be presented.

For that reason, she insisted that the presentation does not represent the
closing of the investigations, but rather the exposition of the “new elements
and where they are leading.”

The president also highlighted that communication is maintained with the
parents of the 43 students through the Undersecretariat of Human Rights of the
Interior Ministry, the Commission for the case and the Attorney General's
Office.

“We have a relationship with them, both through the Interior Undersecretariat
of Human Rights, the Special Commission, and the Attorney General's Office,”
she said. She added that some particular requests from the families are
attended to directly.

She clarified that the information to be released this September 28
corresponds to what was presented to the parents during the last meeting she
held with them at the National Palace.

On the parents' demand for the return of the members of the
**Interdisciplinary Group of Independent Experts (GIEI)** , Sheinbaum Pardo
noted that this group no longer exists because it was **dissolved by the
Inter-American Commission on Human Rights**.

She recalled that when the government asked the United Nations for an
assessment of experts who could support the investigations, it was decided not
to call on the GIEI members again, **but rather to consider other
specialists** , whose incorporation is still in the process of being defined.

Finally, the president announced that she will request the presence of the
**Undersecretary of Human Rights, Population and Migration of the Interior
Ministry, Arturo Medina** , at the September 29 press conference, with the
purpose of **expanding the information related to the new lines of
investigation in the Ayotzinapa case.**
